name: transport-commitlint
cmd: set -euo pipefail; for msg in research/bapa/transport-commit.txt research/bapa/tcommit-transport-commit.txt research/bapa/numeric-transport-commit.txt research/bapa/cutoff-transport-commit.txt research/bapa/control-transport-commit.txt; do bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$msg"; done > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; printf 'five transport commit messages accepted\n' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/result.txt"
